text: Canada uses the word **‘maximum’ **on speed signs. Because speed is measured in kilometres instead of miles, the numbers tend to be higher than the US which can be identifiable from afar.

NOTE: The US uses the words **‘speed limit’ **on such signs. In addition, speed limits ending with 5 are more common in the US, and the ‘speed limit’ text takes up two lines versus one for ‘maximum’ in Canada.
text_zh: 加拿大在速限標誌上使用 **‘maximum’** 這個詞。由於速度是以公里而非英里來衡量，因此數字往往比美國更高，這從遠處就能辨識出來。
注意：美國在此類標誌上使用 **‘speed limit’** 這個詞。此外，以 5 結尾的速限在美國更常見，「speed limit」的文字佔據兩行，而加拿大的「maximum」則是一行。

text: Canadian road signs tend to be **less wordy** compared to their US counterparts. Good examples of this are railroad crossing and yield signs. In the US, these usually have the literal words ‘railroad crossing’ and ‘yield’ written on them, whereas in Canada, these signs are typically** **blank.
text_zh: 與美國相比，加拿大的道路標誌通常**較少文字**。平交道標誌與讓路標誌就是很好的例子。在美國，這些標誌通常寫著 ‘railroad crossing’ 和 ‘yield’ 字樣，而在加拿大，這些標誌通常是** **空白的。

text: The English-speaking parts of Canada use **British English** spelling (e.g. centre; colour). In addition, Canada mostly uses the [metric system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system). For example, speed is measured in **kilometres **per hour.

NOTE: This is useful to distinguish between the US, where American English spelling and (usually) the [imperial system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units) are used. For example, the US measures speed in miles.
text_zh: 加拿大的英語區使用**英式英文**拼音（例如：centre、colour）。此外，加拿大主要採用[公制單位](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system)。例如，速度是以每小時**公里 **計算。
註：這很有助於區分美國，因為美國使用美式英文拼音以及（通常）[英制單位](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units)。例如，美國是以英里來計算速度。

text: Canada uses unique **diamond**-shaped T-Intersection signs.
NOTE: Canada is the only country in the world where you can find these signs. The US, for example, uses rectangular** **T-Intersection signs.
text_zh: 加拿大使用獨特的**菱形** T 字路口標誌。
註：加拿大是世界上唯一能看到這種標誌的國家。例如，美國使用的是矩形** **T 字路口標誌。

text: Canadian roads usually have **single yellow **centre lines. However, double middle yellow centre lines are still decently common.
NOTE: Double yellow centre lines are more common in the US. This is not a 100% reliable clue, so make sure to use this along with other clues.
text_zh: 加拿大的道路通常有**單黃線 **中央標線。不過，雙黃線中央標線依然相當常見。
註：雙黃線中央標線在美國更為常見。這不是一個 100% 完全可靠的線索，因此請務必搭配其他線索一起使用。

text: Canada has a fair amount of **Generation 2 coverage**, especially in rural** **or remote areas. Generation 2 can be recognized by the big circular car blur and the halo-like colour distortion in the sky.
NOTE: Generation 2 is very rare in the US. If you are between Canada and the US, and the location is in Generation 2, you are much more likely to be in Canada.
text_zh: 加拿大有相當數量的**第 2 世代街景覆蓋**，特別是在鄉村** **或偏遠地區。第 2 世代的特徵是車底有大型圓形模糊，以及天空呈現光暈狀的色彩失真。
註：第 2 世代在美國非常罕見。如果你在加拿大與美國之間猶豫，而該地點屬於第 2 世代，那麼很有可能是在加拿大。

text: **Generation 3** is significantly more common in Canada than in the US.
In addition, the side mirrors are blurred out differently: While they generally appear as **two peaks** in Canadian Gen 3 coverage, you will mostly see a single peak in the US.
text_zh: **第 3 世代**在加拿大比在美國普遍得多。
此外，後視鏡的模糊方式也有所不同：加拿大 Gen 3 街景覆蓋中的後視鏡模糊通常會呈現**兩個凸起**，而美國則多半只會看到單個凸起。

text: You can sometimes find **communal mailboxes** in Canada. Personal mailboxes are still very common, though.
Canada Post has a **red logo**, which sometimes appears on mailboxes.
NOTE: These communal mailboxes are very rare in the US. In addition, the US Postal Service has a blue logo.
text_zh: 在加拿大有時會看到**社區集中信箱**。不過個人信箱依然非常普遍。
加拿大郵政（Canada Post）擁有**紅色標誌**，有時會出現在信箱上。
註：這種社區集中信箱在美國非常罕見。此外，美國郵政服務（USPS）的標誌是藍色的。

text: This style of mailbox, resting on top of a post and with a **small flag** on the side, is mostly associated with North America.
text_zh: 這種立在柱子上、側邊帶有**小旗子**的信箱樣式，主要與北美地區相關。

text: North America primarily uses **wooden utility poles**.
Several European countries also primarily use wooden utility poles. However, a concrete pole in particular is mostly associated with Europe.
In addition, the US and Canada use transformers that are **large metallic cylinders**. This will never be seen in European countries.
text_zh: 北美主要使用**木製電線桿**。
幾個歐洲國家也主要使用木製電線桿。不過，水泥電線桿特別容易讓人聯想到歐洲。
此外，美國和加拿大使用的變壓器是**大型金屬圓柱體**。這在歐洲國家絕對看不到。

text: This style of insulator, which is raised slightly on top of the utility pole, can be a good clue for the US and Canada. It is not typically found in Europe. It is especially apparent on simple poles with a single insulator.
text_zh: 這種稍微架高在電線桿頂端的礙子樣式，是分辨美國和加拿大的好線索。在歐洲通常看不到這種樣式。在只有單個礙子的簡單電線桿上尤為明顯。

text: The United States and Canada will usually have **short license plates**. Europe usually uses a **long license plate** which will also have a blue strip on the side.
NOTE: Each province has its own designs. An overview of the specific designs in each province can be seen in step 2.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大通常使用**短車牌**。歐洲通常使用**長車牌**，而且側邊會有藍色條紋。
註：每個省份都有自己的設計。步驟 2 可以看到各省具體設計的總覽。

text: In the US and Canada, especially at large intersections, **long metal bars** with **stop lights** attached to them hang over the street. These bars also commonly have street signs, highway signs, or other signs attached to them.
text_zh: 在美國和加拿大，特別是在大型路口，街道上方會懸掛掛有**紅綠燈**的**長金屬桿**。這些橫桿上也經常掛有路名牌、公路標誌或其他標誌。

text: **Thin metal signposts** are common. They will typically either have several small holes or have a [U profile](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oqFAZpsUpMhbDx5P8).
text_zh: **細金屬標誌桿**很常見。它們通常帶有幾個小孔，或是採用 [U 型截面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oqFAZpsUpMhbDx5P8)。

text: **Water towers** in towns across the United States and Canada are typically very tall, and sometimes have the name of the town on them.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大城鎮中的**水塔**通常非常高大，有時上面會寫有城鎮的名稱。

text: Both the US and Canada also have Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot. When the car isn’t blurred properly, you will usually see a mirror sticking out on the right side.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大也都有第 4 世代「smallcam」街景覆蓋，其架設高度比一般的第 4 世代低，並且下方有一個相對較大的圓形模糊，前端帶有小凸起。該模糊也可能完全透明，使其更難察覺。當車子沒有被完美模糊時，你通常會看到右側凸出一個後視鏡。

text: Each province has its own **unique licence plates**, some recognizable from afar even when blurred. Multiple provinces **do not **require front plates, which can be useful when deciding between provinces.

NOTE: Since 2019, front plates are no longer required in New Brunswick. However, you should still expect to see them in older coverage. As well, all commercial vehicles in Newfoundland and Labrador are required to use front plates, and so it is possible to see them on vans and pickup trucks.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個省份都有自己**獨特的車牌**，有些即使經過模糊處理也能從遠處識別。許多省份**並不 **強制安裝前車牌，這在區分不同省份時非常有用。
註：自 2019 年起，紐布倫斯威克省不再強制要求安裝前車牌。不過在較舊的街景覆蓋中仍可能看到前車牌。此外，紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省的所有商業車輛都必須使用前車牌，因此在廂型車和皮卡車上可能會看到它們。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: French is the majority language in **Québec** and parts of **New Brunswick**.

NOTE: At the federal level, French has official status alongside English, so you can sometimes find bilingual signs in other parts of Canada. In addition, French is also spoken in several communities in Nova Scotia, Ontario and Manitoba.
text_zh: 法文是**魁北克省**以及**紐布倫斯威克省**部分地區的主要語言。
註：在聯邦層級，法文與英文同具官方語言地位，因此在加拿大其他地區有時也能找到雙語標誌。此外，新斯科細亞省、安大略省和曼尼托巴省的幾個社區也使用法文。

text: Each province has their own **highway shields** with unique** **designs.
The green Trans-Canada Highway shield, shown in the top right of the image, can be found in all 10 provinces.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個省份都有自己**公路編號標誌**的獨特** **設計。
圖片右上角所示的綠色橫貫加拿大公路標誌，可以在全部 10 個省份找到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Each province has its own unique** kilometre markers** that vary slightly.
Notably, Ontario KM markers have a **white square** at the bottom, which is unique to the province.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個省份都有微幅差異的獨特**里程碑**。
值得注意的是，安大略省的公里標誌底部有一個**白色方塊**，這是該省獨有的特徵。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Some provinces have **unique speed signs**.
Ontario speed limit signs may have a **black section** on the bottom with the words ‘km/h’ or ‘begins’ written in white.
British Columbian signs also include the ‘km/h’ but **lack **the black section.
Québec can sometimes have **French **on their speed limit signs.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 部分省份擁有**獨特限速標誌**。
安大略省的限速標誌底部可能有一個**黑色區塊**，上面印有白字「km/h」或「begins」。
卑詩省的標誌也包含「km/h」，但**缺少 **黑色區塊。
魁北克省的限速標誌上有時會有**法文 **。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Alberta has a unique **black and white **bollard that is often found at intersections. It has a **cylindrical **shape and two black bands that wrap all the way around. It is one of the most useful Canadian bollards to learn because it appears so frequently.

NOTE: Some Alberta bollards have a [yellow band](https://goo.gl/maps/VocoBEyMAyYWS6TNA) between the two black bands, instead of a white one. [Blue bands](https://www.google.com/maps/@51.0086521,-114.1574649,3a,15y,332.03h,76.57t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1swqH7OVkeCkEWjGass03ahQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) can also rarely be seen, particularly in and around Calgary, while [green bands](https://www.google.com/maps/@53.6289425,-113.3790425,3a,15y,31.12h,80.5t,0.35r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sOAFFhMEkY051OMV8geKMog!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) are rarely seen in and around Edmonton.
text_zh: 亞伯達省擁有獨特的**黑白相間 **路樁，經常出現在路口。它呈現**圓柱形 **，帶有兩道環繞四周的黑色帶狀標示。這是非常值得記憶的加拿大路樁之一，因為它的出現頻率非常高。

註：亞伯達省的部分路樁在兩條黑色帶狀之間是[黃色帶狀](https://goo.gl/maps/VocoBEyMAyYWS6TNA)，而不是白色的。[藍色帶狀](https://www.google.com/maps/@51.0086521,-114.1574649,3a,15y,332.03h,76.57t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1swqH7OVkeCkEWjGass03ahQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)偶爾可見，特別是在卡加利市區及其周邊，而[綠色帶狀](https://www.google.com/maps/@53.6289425,-113.3790425,3a,15y,31.12h,80.5t,0.35r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sOAFFhMEkY051OMV8geKMog!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則極少見於艾德蒙吞及其周邊。

text: Manitoba uses black and grey painted bollards. Most of the time an **orange stripe** will be present below the grey one.
[Wooden, rectangular bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fuj6Rivmhcg3sS5dA) of this form are typically found further north in Manitoba.
NOTE: Bollards in [this](https://goo.gl/maps/BmjVnBrvDfAc66Ym9) format with just a black top are seen in Manitoba and Saskatchewan.
text_zh: 曼尼托巴省使用漆成黑色與灰色的路樁。大多數情況下，灰色條紋下方會有一道**橘色條紋**。
這種形式的[木製矩形路樁](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fuj6Rivmhcg3sS5dA)通常見於曼尼托巴省較北部的地區。
註：僅頂部為黑色的[這種](https://goo.gl/maps/BmjVnBrvDfAc66Ym9)格式路樁可見於曼尼托巴省和薩克其萬省。

text: British Columbia has black-and-white bollards with a thin, slightly curved shape. It is most commonly found on Vancouver Island, but can be found all throughout the province.
NOTE: They can look superficially similar to the Alberta bollard. However, the thin shape and the wider spacing of the two black bands should help you tell them apart.
text_zh: 卑詩省擁有黑白相間的路樁，形狀較細且略帶弧度。最常見於溫哥華島，但全省各地都能找到。
註：它們表面上看起來與亞伯達省的路樁相似。然而，較細的形狀和兩條黑色帶狀之間較寬的間距應能幫助你將它們區分開來。

text: Québec has unique bollards that are always attached to guardrails. They are long, thin white poles with a **red** or **green reflector** at the top.
text_zh: 魁北克省擁有獨特的路樁，且總是附著在護欄上。它們是細長白色的桿子，頂部帶有**紅色**或**綠色反射鏡**。

text: You will often find these **yellow fire hydrant markers** atop signposts in Québec.

In [Québec City](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tXPTbFvb8CWHFhFa7) these markers will usually have a blue rectangle and markers in [Trois-Rivières](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UZwuZs8zfPbjdAFX7) are distinctly small.

NOTE: Sometimes the markers will have [different colours](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dMcGqrRcNb4nB15dA). Beware that [Edmundston](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J3AV6ZypEukym8p96), in New Brunswick, uses these too.
text_zh: 在魁北克省，你經常會在標誌桿頂端看到這種**黃色消防栓標記**。
在[魁北克市](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tXPTbFvb8CWHFhFa7)，這些標記通常會有一個藍色矩形，而[三河市](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UZwuZs8zfPbjdAFX7)的標記則明顯偏小。
註：有時這些標記會呈現[不同顏色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dMcGqrRcNb4nB15dA)。注意紐布倫斯威克省的[艾德蒙斯頓](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J3AV6ZypEukym8p96)也使用這種標記。

text: You can find these **rectangular markers** on the sides of the roads in Québec. The colours can vary.
NOTE: These can be rarely found on urban divided highways in New Brunswick.
text_zh: 你可以在魁北克省的道路兩側看到這種**矩形標記**。顏色可能有所不同。
註：這些標記偶爾也會出現在紐布倫斯威克省的城市分隔公路上。

text: You can find these **diamond-shaped markers** on the sides of the roads in Ontario. The colours can vary.
text_zh: 你可以在安大略省的道路兩側看到這種**菱形標記**。顏色可能有所不同。

text: The Northwest Territories has a black and white bollard with a cylindrical shape and two **thick**, **black **bands.
NOTE: It looks very similar to the Alberta bollard. However, the Alberta bollard has thinner black bands.
text_zh: 西北地區擁有圓柱形的黑白路樁，帶有兩道**粗**、**黑色 **帶狀標示。
註：它看起來與亞伯達省的路樁非常相似。不過，亞伯達省路樁的黑色帶狀較細。

text: The transformers on poles will **face **the road in British Columbia and New Brunswick, while in [other provinces](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.597191,-71.9607213,3a,37.3y,356.7h,112.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1skt1xgBKW1zae9FlYAHS5lg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192), it will be **parallel **with the wires.
text_zh: 卑詩省和紐布倫斯威克省電線桿上的變壓器會**面向 **道路，而在[其他省份](https://www.google.com/maps/@45.597191,-71.9607213,3a,37.3y,356.7h,112.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1skt1xgBKW1zae9FlYAHS5lg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則會與電線**平行 **。

text: Transformers on Prince Edward Island and Nova Scotia will be installed at a 45° angle relative to the road. On PEI, red numbers will usually be written on the side.
text_zh: 愛德華王子島和新斯科細亞省的變壓器安裝角度與道路呈 45° 角。在愛德華王子島，側邊通常會寫有紅色數字。

text: Insulators facing **towards or away from the road** are mostly found in Québec, Nova Scotia, and Prince Edward Island. Other provinces tend to have their insulators facing the same direction as the road.
NOTE: This is most trustworthy when the pole is not at an intersection or driveway.
text_zh: 礙子**朝向或背對道路**主要見於魁北克省、新斯科細亞省與愛德華王子島。其他省份的礙子則多半朝向與道路相同的方向。
註：當電線桿不在路口或車道旁時，此線索最為可靠。

text: These distinctive pole tops are most commonly found in Ontario. They have two insulators to the **side**, and one on **top**. The side insulators are affixed to the pole with a distinct** **attachment. Sometimes, multiple of them can be [stacked](https://goo.gl/maps/ZVECCo5w5KVtJRmT6) on top of each other.
NOTE: They can occasionally appear in British Columbia, Nova Scotia, or other provinces more rarely.
text_zh: 這些特殊的電線桿頂端最常見於安大略省。它們在**兩側**各有一個礙子，**頂端**則有一個。側邊礙子是用獨特的** **固定配件安裝在桿上。有時多組這樣的結構會互相[重疊堆疊](https://goo.gl/maps/ZVECCo5w5KVtJRmT6)。
註：它們偶爾會出現在卑詩省、新斯科細亞省，或是更罕見於其他省份。

text: Some Québec poles have recognizable pole tops with insulator rods that are **angled slightly upwards**.
text_zh: 部分魁北克省的電線桿頂端可辨識，其礙子棒**稍微向上傾斜**。

text: Pole top insulators in Saskatchewan **alternate**. While one pole will have one insulator on the left and two on the right, the next will have two on the left and one on the right.
NOTE: This can rarely be seen in [Manitoba](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JMD7VTJPjWEMyet77).
text_zh: 薩克其萬省的電線桿頂礙子會**交替出現**。當一根電線桿為左邊一個礙子、右邊兩個礙子時，下一根就會變成左邊兩個礙子、右邊一個礙子。
註：這在[曼尼托巴省](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JMD7VTJPjWEMyet77)極為罕見。

text: Poles with **two hanging insulators** are common in Manitoba.
text_zh: 帶有**兩個懸掛式礙子**的電線桿在曼尼托巴省很常見。

text: Québec poles may sometimes have a vertical **black and yellow **label. There is a small **‘Q’** in the black part.
text_zh: 魁北克省的電線桿有時帶有垂直的**黑黃相間 **標籤。黑色部分有一個小小的 **「Q」**。

text: Poles on Prince Edward Island usually feature a **small white sticker**.
text_zh: 愛德華王子島上的電線桿通常帶有**白色小貼紙**。

text: Québec T-Intersection signs **do not **feature the chequerboard pattern.
text_zh: 魁北克省的 T 字路口標誌**不 **具備棋盤格圖案。

text: Newfoundland T-Intersection signs feature a **rectangular yellow border** around the diamond shape.
text_zh: 紐芬蘭的 T 字路口標誌在菱形外圍帶有**黃色矩形外框**。

text: Road signs in British Columbia can have **green** backsides.
NOTE: Green backsides are also somewhat common on Prince Edward Island.
text_zh: 卑詩省的道路標誌背面可以是**綠色**的。
註：綠色背面在愛德華王子島上也算常見。

text: Signs in British Columbia are sometimes hung down from these unique signposts.
text_zh: 卑詩省的標誌有時會從這種獨特的標誌桿上懸掛下來。

text: You can sometimes find a **green and white** striped sticker on signposts in Manitoba.
text_zh: 在曼尼托巴省的標誌桿上，有時可以找到**綠白相間**的條紋貼紙。

text: Signposts in Saskatchewan can feature these **white triangles**. The number can vary.
text_zh: 薩克其萬省的標誌桿上會有這種**白色三角形**。數字可能會有所不同。

text: Stop signs with the word **‘Arrêt’ **are unique to Québec.
text_zh: 帶有 **‘Arrêt’** 字樣的停止標誌是魁北克特有的。

text: Stop signs with both **‘Stop’ and ‘Arrêt’** are most commonly found in New Brunswick.
NOTE: Such stop signs can rarely be found in other provinces.
text_zh: 同時印有 **「Stop」與「Arrêt」** 的 Stop 標誌最常見於紐布倫斯威克省。
註：此類 Stop 標誌極少出現在其他省份。

text: Like the stop signs, street signs in New Brunswick are also bilingual.
Though unlike the stop signs, bilingual street signs are found in other French minority areas of Canada.
text_zh: 與 Stop 標誌一樣，紐布倫斯威克省的路名牌也是雙語的。
不過與 Stop 標誌不同的是，雙語路名牌也可以在加拿大其他法文少數族群地區看到。

text: Rural roads in Alberta are numbered sequentially. This makes it easy to figure out your exact location using just a road sign.
- **Township roads** (Twp Rd) run east to west. Their numbers increase the more north you go.
- **Range roads** (Rge Rd) run north to south. Their numbers increase the more west you go. These numbers reset a couple of times.

[This infographic](/images/canada/canada_albertatownshipgrid.png) shows which numbers are found where. You need to multiply the numbers on the grid by 10 to get the road numbers. For example, the junction in the image example is found just north of Red Deer.
NOTE: Similarly named roads can also sometimes be seen in Saskatchewan, however they are more common in Alberta.
text_zh: 亞伯達省的鄉村道路按順序編號。這讓你僅憑道路標誌就能輕鬆確定具體位置。
- **鄉鎮道路**（Twp Rd）呈東西走向。越往北走，編號越大。
- **範圍道路**（Rge Rd）呈南北走向。越往西走，編號越大。這些編號會重置數次。
[這張圖表](/images/canada/canada_albertatownshipgrid.png)顯示了各編號的分佈位置。你需要將網格上的數字乘以 10 才能得到道路編號。例如，圖例中的交叉路口位於紅鹿市正北方。
註：類似命名的道路偶爾也會出現在薩克其萬省，不過在亞伯達省更常見。

text: Rural roads in Manitoba are organised in a grid and referred to only by their number and cardinal direction.
- Roads ending in **N** run east to west. Their numbers increase by one for every mile north of the US border.
- Roads with **E** or **W** run north to south. They tell you their position relative to the principal meridian, located just west of Winnipeg.
For instance, this image was taken 105 miles north of the US border and 147 miles west of the principal meridian.
text_zh: 曼尼托巴省的鄉村道路呈網格狀規劃，僅以數字和方位來命名。
- 以 **N** 結尾的道路呈東西走向。美加邊界以北每增加一英里，數字就增加一。
- 帶有 **E** 或 **W** 的道路呈南北走向。它們標示出相對於首要子午線（位於溫尼伯正西側）的位置。
例如，這張照片拍於美加邊界以北 105 英里、首要子午線以西 147 英里之處。

text: British Columbia predominantly uses **concrete barriers** instead of guardrails.
text_zh: 卑詩省主要使用**水泥護欄**而非一般護欄。

text: This guardrail, with **small poles** connected by **three** or **four metal wires**, can rarely be found on major highways in Alberta.
text_zh: 這種由**小柱子**與**三**或**四根金屬線**連接組成的護欄，極少見於亞伯達省的主要公路上。

text: In Ontario, you will often see these types of guardrails. They consist of **cylindrical wooden posts**, held together by precisely **three metal wires**. Some posts are marked by a reflective white band.
text_zh: 在安大略省，你經常會看到這種類型的護欄。它們由**圓柱形木柱**組成，精確地由**三根金屬線**固定在一起。部分木柱帶有反光白色帶狀標示。

text: In Newfoundland and Labrador, most wooden posts on guardrails have this **pyramid** shaped top. Occasionally, you can spot them on [standalone posts](https://goo.gl/maps/hBq3pYWKuD2MkgFQ7) and [signposts](https://goo.gl/maps/grcv9vSj4wF5MUzZ7) as well.
text_zh: 在紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省，護欄上的大部分木柱都帶有這種**金字塔**形頂端。偶爾你也能在[獨立立柱](https://goo.gl/maps/hBq3pYWKuD2MkgFQ7)和[標誌桿](https://goo.gl/maps/grcv9vSj4wF5MUzZ7)上看到它們。

text: Fire hydrants in Newfoundland often have a **diamond-shaped marker** next to them.
text_zh: 紐芬蘭的消防栓旁邊通常會有一個**菱形標記**。

text: You can spot these **wooden boxes** holding up signs in Newfoundland and Labrador.
text_zh: 你可以在紐芬蘭與拉布拉多省看到支撐標誌的**木盒**。

text: Within Eastern Canada, **double yellow lines** are most common in Nova Scotia, followed by Québec and Prince Edward Island. Ontario prefers single yellow lines for this purpose, but will occasionally use them.
_For some empirical research, please see this [document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/15DuGdsvKMqv5O-XiFwhNuczw89jVqg8XycY7brvhjP4/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.vhodl2gtolwe)._
text_zh: 在加拿大東部，**雙黃線**最常見於新斯科細亞省，其次是魁北克省和愛德華王子島。安大略省在相同用途上更偏好單黃線，但偶爾也會使用雙黃線。
_欲了解一些實證研究，請參閱這份[文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/15DuGdsvKMqv5O-XiFwhNuczw89jVqg8XycY7brvhjP4/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.vhodl2gtolwe)。_

text: You can sometimes find **white dashes** between the yellow centre lines in Saskatchewan.
text_zh: 在薩克其萬省，有時可以在黃色中央標線之間看到**白色虛線**。

text: Rumble strips **in the centre of the road **(generally over the roadlines) are most common in Alberta and British Columbia.
text_zh: **位於路中央**的減速震動線（通常位於道路標線上）在亞伯達省與英屬哥倫比亞省最為常見。

text: Ontario uses distinct [**orange and black**](https://goo.gl/maps/962rfJYMzZ8SikSd6)** **striped traffic cones.
Québec, on the other hand, has unique [**orange and white**](https://goo.gl/maps/V1dsFKvJxoSxAVQz5) striped traffic cones.
text_zh: 安大略省使用獨特的[**橘黑相間**](https://goo.gl/maps/962rfJYMzZ8SikSd6)** **條紋交通錐。
另一方面，魁北克省則有獨特的[**橘白相間**](https://goo.gl/maps/V1dsFKvJxoSxAVQz5)條紋交通錐。

text: **Québec **is the only Canadian province that uses **red and white** chevrons.
NOTE: The rest of Canada uses the classic [yellow and black](https://goo.gl/maps/FQY3a1oqcfZTyGPs7) chevrons.
text_zh: **魁北克省**是加拿大唯一使用**紅白相間**轉彎標誌的省份。
註：加拿大其他地區則使用經典的[黃黑相間](https://goo.gl/maps/FQY3a1oqcfZTyGPs7)轉彎標誌。

text: New Brunswick and Nova Scotia commonly use lampheads with a rectangular shape.
text_zh: 紐布倫斯威克省與新斯科細亞省常使用矩形的路燈燈頭。

text: Lamp arms on utility poles in Nova Scotia are usually curved and **much shorter** than in the [rest of Canada.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/f8W98cYyaK7do5oa7)
NOTE: Short lamp arms may occasionally be found in other parts of Canada.
text_zh: 新斯科細亞省電線桿上的燈臂通常呈彎曲狀，且比[加拿大其他地區](https://maps.app.goo.gl/f8W98cYyaK7do5oa7)**短得多**。
註：短燈臂偶爾也會在加拿大的其他地區看到。

text: Bins made of **wood **planks can be seen on Newfoundland driveways. These are most commonly **octagonal**,** **however they can have other shapes.
NOTE: Although they are most common in Newfoundland, they can also sometimes be seen in other provinces, such as [New Brunswick](https://goo.gl/maps/PCnuxKNs65VkeDqNA).
text_zh: 在紐芬蘭的住宅車道上可以看到**木**板製成的箱子。這些箱子最常呈**八角形**，** **但也有其他形狀。
註：雖然它們在紐芬蘭最常見，但有時也會在其他省份看到，例如[紐布倫斯威克省](https://goo.gl/maps/PCnuxKNs65VkeDqNA)。

text: Western Canada is very **mountainous**. The highest mountains are in British Columbia, western Alberta, and parts of Yukon. Outside these provinces, large mountains are rare to non-existent in Canada.
text_zh: 加拿大西部**地形多山**。最高聳的山脈位於英屬哥倫比亞省、亞伯達省西部以及育空的部分地區。除了這些省份外，加拿大其他地方極少或完全沒有大山。

text: Yukon has a very northern, **boreal landscape** that is mostly **hilly**,** **sometimes** **with [large mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/j7jVz8vNP3EczZRF8)** **in the distance. Coniferous** **trees line the roads and the further north you go, the thinner and shorter** **the trees get. Older [Generation 2 coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/EuhTiy8inFfLy7BF8) is common in this region.
text_zh: 育空擁有非常偏北的**寒帶景觀**，地形多為**丘陵**，** **有時** **遠處會有[高山](https://goo.gl/maps/j7jVz8vNP3EczZRF8)** **。針葉** **樹沿著道路排列，越往北走，樹木就越稀疏矮小** **。較舊的 [Generation 2 街景覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/EuhTiy8inFfLy7BF8) 在這個地區很常見。

text: The landscape in the interior of southern British Columbia, mostly centred around the towns of **Kamloops and Kelowna**, has a distinct look. It is generally hilly and a little more arid than the rest of BC. The vegetation consists of sprawling brown grasslands, and pine tree forests on the hillsides.
text_zh: 英屬哥倫比亞省南部內陸地區（主要以**甘露市與基隆拿**等城鎮為中心）的景觀非常獨特。這裡總體多丘陵，比英屬哥倫比亞省的其他地區稍微乾旱一些。植被由廣袤的褐色草地和山坡上的松樹林組成。

text: The **Great Plains** are mostly flat, with some rolling hills. There is a lot of agriculture, very few trees, and it is very sparsely populated. The landscape gets drier the further south-southwest you go, with the driest parts near the border with the US state of Montana.
text_zh: **大平原**大多地勢平坦，帶有部分起伏的丘陵。當地農業發達，樹木極少，人口非常稀少。越往西南方走景觀越乾燥，最乾燥的區域靠近美國蒙大拿州的邊界。

text: Canola is grown in the **central southern** prairies, and it can be found almost nowhere else in Canada. It is visually similar to a field of bright **yellow flowers**.
NOTE: Canola is also very common in the US state of North Dakota.
text_zh: 芥花種植於**中南部**大草原，在加拿大其他地方幾乎看不到。視覺上它看起來就像是一整片鮮**黃色的花海**。
註：芥花在美國北達科他州也非常常見。

text: The region around Rouyn-Noranda in northwestern Québec can mainly be characterised by the **north-south grid, **along with the **slightly hilly** landscape featuring many agricultural fields nestled between the forests, which have many shorter trees as well as thin birches.
text_zh: 魁北克省西北部魯安-諾蘭達周邊地區的主要特徵為**南北向的網格狀道路，**以及**微起伏的丘陵**地形，森林之間鑲嵌著許多農田，森林中有許多較矮小的樹木與纖細的樺樹。

text: Southern Saskatchewan has many river valleys, which means that the province can have a barren **hilly landscape**; much more so than the rest of the Canadian Great Plains, which tends to be really flat.
NOTE: Some of this hilliness extends into southern Alberta and Manitoba.
text_zh: 薩斯喀徹溫省南部有許多河谷，這意味著該省擁有較為荒涼的**丘陵地形**；比起加拿大其他非常平坦的大平原區域要起伏得多。
註：部分丘陵地形延伸到了亞伯達省南部與曼尼托巴省。

text: **Aspen trees** are common in the forested parts of Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta. They are recognizable by their white, birch-like trunks. In most seasons, they have regular green leaves, but in fall coverage, they turn a characteristic bright yellow colour.
text_zh: **顫楊**在曼尼托巴省、薩斯喀徹溫省和亞伯達省的森林地區很常見。牠們可透過類似樺樹的白色樹幹來辨認。在大多數季節裡牠們長著普通綠葉，但在秋季街景覆蓋中，會轉變為特有的鮮黃色。

text: The Canadian Shield extends through the eastern part of Canada. Therefore, you will commonly see **exposed rocks** on street view in the highlighted area.
text_zh: 加拿大地盾貫穿加拿大東部。因此，在標示的區域內，你經常會在街景中看到**裸露的岩石**。

text: The **Québec City-Windsor Corridor** is the most densely populated part of Canada. It is mostly flat and green, with a patchwork of agriculture and occasional forest cover.
NOTE: This area can look similar to the Great Lakes region in the US.
text_zh: **魁北克市-溫莎走廊**是加拿大人口最密集的區域。當地大多平坦且一片綠意，交織著農田與偶爾出現的森林覆蓋。
註：這個區域看起來可能與美國的五大湖地區相似。

text: Prince Edward Island soil has a distinct **red **tint to it. Potato farming is also very common on PEI.
NOTE: This type of soil can occasionally be seen in certain areas of New Brunswick and Nova Scotia.
text_zh: 愛德華王子島的土壤帶有獨特的**紅**色調。馬鈴薯種植在愛德華王子島也非常普遍。
註：這種土壤偶爾也可以在紐布倫斯威克省和新斯科細亞省的某些區域看到。

text: The **Balsam Fir **is a very common** **species of tree found in Newfoundland. It has a Christmas tree-like appearance.

NOTE: While most commonly found in Newfoundland, the Balsam Fir can also grow in other parts of Eastern Canada and the US. For an overview, see [this](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d8/Abies_balsamea_range_map_3.png/1280px-Abies_balsamea_range_map_3.png) map.
text_zh: **香脂冷杉**在紐芬蘭是非常常見** **的樹種。它的外觀看起來像聖誕樹。
註：雖然香脂冷杉最常見於紐芬蘭，但它也會生長在加拿大東部其他地區與美國。如需概覽，請參見[這張](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d8/Abies_balsamea_range_map_3.png/1280px-Abies_balsamea_range_map_3.png)地圖。

text: Canadian phone numbers start with a **three-digit area code**. Both landlines and mobile phones use the same area codes.
NOTE: Canadian phone numbers are formatted XXX XXX XXXX, with the area code being the first three digits. It is fairly common to see 7-digit numbers with the area code omitted.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 加拿大的電話號碼以**三位數的區號**開頭。市話和手機都使用相同的區號。
註：加拿大電話號碼格式為 XXX XXX XXXX，前三位數為區號。省略區號的 7 位數號碼相當常見。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Provincial flags** appear decently often. The [Fleurdelisé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_of_Quebec) of Québec in particular is very common.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **省旗**相當常出現。特別是魁北克的[百合花旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_of_Quebec)非常常見。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Acadia** is a French-speaking cultural region in the Canadian Maritimes without clearly defined borders. It is usually understood to at least include north and east New Brunswick, with some isolated communities in Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island.

It has its own flag, which is a French-style tricolour with a yellow star in the blue band. It can be seen either flown or painted on [poles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4VfcnD6JmdyFURQD8) in this region.
text_zh: **阿卡迪亞**是加拿大海洋省份中一個沒有明確邊界的法語文化區。通常理解為至少包含紐布倫斯威克省北部與東部，以及新斯科細亞省和愛德華王子島的一些孤立社區。
它有自己的旗幟，是帶有黃色星星在藍條紋上的法式三色旗。在該地區可以看見這面旗幟懸掛或繪製在[電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4VfcnD6JmdyFURQD8)上。

text: These flat, **yellow bollards** can be found on the Trans-Canada highway in New Brunswick.
text_zh: 這些扁平的**黃色路樁**可以在紐布倫斯威克省的橫加公路上找到。

text: The **Dempster Highway** (road numbers 5 and 8) connects the Klondike Highway (road number 2) in Yukon with the remote town of Inuvik in the Northwest Territories.

It is very recognizable: it is an unpaved road with Generation 2 coverage, **dark brown** soil, and a tundra landscape with **short trees**. It is mostly hilly and mountainous, but the section between Fort McPherson and Inuvik is flat. Closer to Inuvik, the weather gets cloudy.
text_zh: **鄧普斯特公路**（5 號與 8 號公路）連接育空的克朗代克公路（2 號公路）與西北地區偏遠的因奴維克鎮。
它非常容易辨認：是一條未鋪設泥土路，具有 Generation 2 街景覆蓋、**深褐色**土壤，以及帶有**矮樹**的苔原景觀。地形大多為丘陵與山地，但麥克弗森堡與因奴維克之間的路段平坦。越靠近因奴維克，天氣就越陰沉。

text: The **Top of the World Highway** west of Dawson City in Yukon has overcast Generation 2 coverage and is located mostly high up in the mountains, making it recognizable.
text_zh: 位於育空道森市以西的**世界之頂公路**擁有陰天的 Generation 2 街景覆蓋，且大部分位於高山之上，這使其非常容易辨認。

text: A group of **motorcyclists **can be seen in front of the Google car on this stretch of Highway 1 near Beaver Creek in Yukon.
text_zh: 在育空海狸溪附近的 1 號公路這段路上記錄到，Google 車前方有一群**摩托車騎士**。

text: The AB-93 highway through Banff and Jasper National Park features distinct, gradual, and steep mountains with a **sharp **peak on either side of the road. Tall, somewhat thin trees can also be seen.
text_zh: 穿過班夫與賈斯珀國家公園的 AB-93 公路特色是道路兩側都有陡峭、山勢漸升且具有**尖銳**山峰的山脈。也可以看到高大但稍微纖細的樹木。

text: The area near Drumheller, Alberta has distinct canyon-like **treeless **rock formations that comprise the landscape.
text_zh: 亞伯達省德拉姆黑勒附近的區域具有獨特的峽谷狀**無樹**岩石地貌構成景觀。

text: The **Trans-Labrador Highway** (road numbers 500 and 510) is a recognizable road, covered by Generation 4, mostly during sunny weather conditions. Thin pine** **trees line the side of the road, and it has a remote, cold, and northern feel. On many parts of the road, the sun is low in the sky. In addition, when the car drives past the city of **Happy Valley-Goose Bay**, it is common to see [snow on the ground](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oGGyzG5H1sVvQot78).
text_zh: **橫拉布拉多公路**（500 號與 510 號公路）是一條特徵鮮明的道路，由 Generation 4 拍攝，大多處於晴朗天氣。道路兩側排列著纖細的松** **樹，帶有一種偏遠、寒冷且偏北的感覺。在該公路的許多路段，太陽仰角都很低。此外，當車輛開過**歡喜谷-鵝灣**市時，常見到[地面上有積雪](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oGGyzG5H1sVvQot78)。

text: QC-167 and QC-113 are covered in Gen 3 and identifiable for their **overcast autumn** coverage, often with **snow** on the ground. In addition, a [smudge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8TUyRYbPxNvXMX2m9) can be seen on this road.
text_zh: QC-167 與 QC-113 由 Gen 3 覆蓋，其特徵是**陰天的秋季**街景覆蓋，地面上常有**積雪**。此外，這條路上還可以看到[鏡頭污漬](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8TUyRYbPxNvXMX2m9)。

text: The inland roads of the **Gaspé Peninsula** feature densely forested mountainous terrain. It is particularly common to encounter **overcast **coverage in this region.
text_zh: **加斯佩半島**的內陸道路以森林密佈的山地地形為特色。在這個區域特別容易遇到**陰天**的街景覆蓋。

text: The **Cape Breton Highlands** in northeastern Nova Scotia have an unusual amount of elevation for Eastern Canadian standards. It is very forested, with a mix of broad-leaf trees and pine trees.
text_zh: 新斯科細亞省東北部的**布雷頓角高地**（Cape Breton Highlands）以東加拿大標準來看，有著異常起伏的地形。這裡森林茂密，生長著闊葉林與松樹的混合林。

text: **Route 430 **on Newfoundland runs in a roughly south-southwest to north-northeast direction, with the road lines slightly washed out. It is located in a remote and sparsely populated part of the island. On many sections of the road, the coast is visible to your west. To your east, you will usually see low **balsam fir** forests, and occasionally an imposing [wall of mountains](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.81276,-57.8695694,3a,90y,101.84h,97.1t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sR6Wwvxu7AYQ_tISVDbXjzg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656) in the far distance.
text_zh: 紐芬蘭島上的**430號公路**（Route 430）大致呈南南西至北北東走向，道路標線稍微有些褪色。它位於該島偏遠且人口稀疏的地區。在這條路的許多路段，往西可以看見海岸。往東通常會看到低矮的**膠冷杉**（balsam fir）森林，遠處偶爾還能看到壯觀的[山牆](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.81276,-57.8695694,3a,90y,101.84h,97.1t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sR6Wwvxu7AYQ_tISVDbXjzg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)。

text: Iqaluit is the capital of Nunavut, meaning it is **more urban**, and built up compared to other Nunavut settlements. The city features bilingual **turquoise street signs**. Speed limit signs are also uniquely bilingual. And on the outskirts of the city, these unique road markers can be seen.
text_zh: 伊奎特（Iqaluit）是努納福特（Nunavut）的首府，這意味著與其他努納福特定居點相比，這裡**較為都市化**且建設較完善。該市特色是擁有雙語的**綠松石色街道標誌**。速限標誌也是獨特的雙語標誌。而在城市郊區，可以看到這些獨特的道路標記。

text: The remote town of Churchill in northern Manitoba features a trekker with a distinct thin **antenna **visible on the front right side of the car. The town also has unique street signs.
NOTE: This coverage is also seen in the surrounding area.
text_zh: 曼尼托巴省北部的偏遠小鎮邱吉爾（Churchill）具有徒步拍攝街景，其車頭右前方明顯可見一根細長的**天線**。該鎮也擁有獨特的街道標誌。
注意：周遭地區也能看到這種街景覆蓋。

text: This unique Google car and **dark**-coloured soil is found in Tulita, NWT. The car will most often look like this, but can also be fully blurred with just the **antenna** visible, or with the hood of the car visible.
text_zh: 西北地區（NWT）的圖利塔（Tulita）可以找到這種獨特的 Google 車和**深**色土壤。這台車多數時候看起來會是這樣，但也可能完全被模糊處理只看得見**天線**，或者看得到車頭蓋。

text: Sanikiluaq is a remote town situated **in Hudson Bay**. This snowy town was covered by a snowmobile whose driver wore a dark **brown **coat.
NOTE: Snowmobile coverage can be found [outside](https://goo.gl/maps/7xhV916CkhjwrEhU8) the town on the ice-covered sea, where the driver is **not **visible.
text_zh: 薩尼基盧阿克（Sanikiluaq）是位於**哈德遜灣**（Hudson Bay）中的偏遠城鎮。這個雪景城鎮是由一台雪上摩托車拍攝的，駕駛穿著深**棕**色外套。
注意：在冰封的海面上，也就是城鎮[外圍](https://goo.gl/maps/7xhV916CkhjwrEhU8)，可以找到雪上摩托車街景，在那裡**看不到**駕駛。

text: Inukjuak is a town in northern Québec. This town can be recognized by the **snowmobile **that is** **visible through the blur.
NOTE: In Sanikiluaq, the other town with snowmobile coverage, you will always see the driver.
text_zh: 因庫朱阿克（Inukjuak）是魁北克北部的一個城鎮。這個城鎮可以透過在模糊處理中隱約**可見**的**雪上摩托車**來辨識。
注意：在薩尼基盧阿克這個另一個擁有雪上摩托車街景的城鎮，你總是會看到駕駛。

text: Grise Fiord is the northernmost covered town in Canada. It can easily be recognized by these **unique mountains** and the ice floes on the coast.
text_zh: 葛里斯菲奧德是加拿大最北端有街景覆蓋的城鎮。透過這些**獨特的山脈**和海岸上的浮冰就能輕鬆認出它。

text: The northern town of Resolute can be recognized by the **barren **landscape with visible **patches of snow**.
text_zh: 北方城鎮雷索盧特可以透過**荒涼的**景觀與隨處可見的**殘雪**來辨識。

text: Cambridge Bay is the only Nunavut settlement to have **Generation 2** trekker coverage.
text_zh: 劍橋灣是努納武特地區唯一擁有**第 2 世代**徒步拍攝街景覆蓋的聚落。

text: The town of Qikiqtarjuaq features distinct **mountains**, and **red tinted soil**.
text_zh: 奇奇克塔盧阿克鎮的特徵是顯眼的**山脈**與**偏紅的土壤**。

text: Kangiqsualujjuaq is a town in northern Québec, surrounded by **green rocky hills**, with trees visible in the distance.
text_zh: 康吉蘇阿盧朱阿克是魁北克北部的城鎮，被**綠色的岩石丘陵**環繞，遠處可以看到樹木。

text: Nain is a small town on the Northeastern coast of Labrador. The town features **colourful wooden houses**, and **trees **in and around the town. To the north, a [big hill](https://goo.gl/maps/UeGydx1F6QdyViVg7) is usually visible. And to the south, [rocky cliffs](https://goo.gl/maps/YPww4ALKREgUZNrj6) can be seen on the other side of the bay. Additionally, kids can sometimes be seen walking beside the trekker.
text_zh: 內恩（Nain）是拉布拉多東北海岸的小鎮。該鎮的特色是**色彩繽紛的木屋**，且鎮內及周邊有**樹木**。朝北通常可以看到[大山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/UeGydx1F6QdyViVg7)。朝南則可以在海灣對岸看到[岩石峭壁](https://goo.gl/maps/YPww4ALKREgUZNrj6)。此外，有時候可以看到小孩走在跟拍車旁邊。

text: Red Bay is a town on the southern coast of Labrador, and as such, the **coast **is always visible. It features slightly **red soil**, and most of the houses are painted white.
text_zh: 紅貝（Red Bay）是拉布拉多南海岸的一個城鎮，因此**海岸**總是清晰可見。這裡有微帶**紅色土壤**，且大多數房子的漆成白色。

text: The **northernmost Google Street View coverage in the world** is a trekker on Ellesmere Island in northern Nunavut. It shows a glacier in a rocky, desolate landscape that is devoid of any vegetation.

NOTE: This coverage is sometimes used in maps to improve and standardise the scoring range. As a result, you might encounter this trekker in competitive maps like ACW, despite it not being pinpointable.
text_zh: **全世界最北的 Google 街景覆蓋**是位於努納福特北部埃爾斯米爾島（Ellesmere Island）上的徒步拍攝街景。它展示了荒涼岩石景觀中的冰川，該處完全沒有任何植被。
注意：這種街景有時會被地圖拿來改善並標準化評分範圍。因此，儘管它無法精確定位，你還是可能會在 ACW 等競技地圖中遇到這個徒步拍攝街景。
